changes.general_clarity_change: Keep each operation’s survival effect and destruction-Fear consequence together
changes.old:
| Instruction | Effect on the piece |
| --- | --- |
| **Damage** | Mark Damage; reaching Health destroys the piece immediately. |
| **Destroy** | Return the specified piece to supply regardless of Health or marked Damage. |
| **Remove** | Take the specified piece off the board without a Damage-to-Health test. |
| **Replace** | Remove the original piece and put the specified new piece in its place, retaining marked Damage. |
changes.new:
| Instruction | Effect on the piece | Destruction Fear |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **Damage** | Mark Damage; reaching Health destroys the piece immediately. | If this destroys a Town/City, gain 1/2 Fear respectively, in addition to explicit Fear. |
| **Destroy** | Return the specified piece to supply regardless of Health or marked Damage. | A Town/City generates 1/2 Fear respectively, in addition to explicit Fear. |
| **Remove** | Take the specified piece off the board without a Damage-to-Health test. | None from removal; explicit Fear still applies. |
| **Replace** | Remove the original piece and put the specified new piece in its place, retaining marked Damage. | None from replacement itself. If retained Damage destroys the new Town/City, gain 1/2 Fear respectively, in addition to explicit Fear. |

changes.general_clarity_change: Present Fear generation as a sequential refill loop with immediate divider timing
changes.old: Fear is island-wide. For each Fear, move one marker from the Fear Pool to Generated Fear. When all **4 per Spirit** markers have moved, earn the top Fear Card face-down, return all markers to the pool and continue with any leftover Fear toward the next card. If earning a card exposes a Terror divider, the new Terror Level applies immediately; its victory condition can end the game at the outcome check. Earning the final card reveals Victory; its text never needs resolving.
changes.new:
Fear is island-wide. Process generated Fear **one point at a time**:

1. Move one marker from the Fear Pool to Generated Fear.
2. As soon as Generated Fear holds all **4 per Spirit** markers, earn the top Fear Card face-down. Apply any newly exposed Terror Level immediately, then return all markers to the Fear Pool **before processing the next point**.
3. Repeat for every remaining point of Fear, continuing toward the next card after each refill.

A newly exposed Terror Level changes the victory condition immediately; the game can end at the outcome check. Earning the final card reveals Victory; its text never needs resolving.

changes.general_clarity_change: Attach ownership to the lost Presence while keeping the Dahan trigger unrestricted
changes.old: - **Thunderspeaker:** Presence may accompany each moved Dahan, including generic Move as well as Gather/Push; two Dahan can carry two Presence. **Sworn to Victory** triggers after an entire single-land Ravage for each Dahan destroyed there: destroy one of Thunderspeaker's Presence within Range 1 per Dahan, even if no Blight was added. Finish the Ravage, cascades and counterattack before this triggered loss. [Core: .bu6oc6l, .bu6oc73, .bu6ofsi]
changes.new: - **Thunderspeaker:** Presence may accompany each moved Dahan, including generic Move as well as Gather/Push; two Dahan can carry two Presence. **Sworn to Victory:** finish the entire single-land Ravage, including Blight, cascades and counterattack, then count every Dahan destroyed in that Ravage. **For each destroyed Dahan, Thunderspeaker destroys one of its own Presence within Range 1 of the Ravaged land**, even if no Blight was added. [Core: .bu6oc6l, .bu6oc73, .bu6ofsi]

changes.general_clarity_change: Keep Bringer’s per-piece Fear and movement beside its per-use accumulation rule
changes.old: No real Damage is marked, so different Powers or a Repeat cannot combine their hypothetical Damage; multiple instructions **within one Power** can.
changes.new: For each Invader that this Power use would destroy, gain **0/2/5 Fear for an Explorer/Town/City**, respectively; Push only the Explorer or Town. No real Damage is marked, so different Powers or a Repeat cannot combine their hypothetical Damage; multiple instructions **within one Power** can.
